headline: Binance Restores Global Withdrawals After Record Cyberattack and $3.6B Exodus
summary: Binance has begun restoring cryptocurrency withdrawals globally, including across African markets, after covering 95% of assets stolen in a $6.3 billion cyberattack that triggered $3.6 billion in customer withdrawals.
why: Security breaches and liquidity outflows at the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange raise confidence risks across digital asset markets.
why_moved: A multi-billion dollar breach at a leading global exchange severely impacts trader confidence and triggers broad liquidity outflows.
